body.zh-Hant: 尼古拉一世1841年10月7日生於涅古什（Njeguš）。他童年多在採蒂涅度過，並在的里雅斯特與巴黎就讀中學。1860年他中斷學業，接替在卡塔羅遇刺的叔父丹尼洛親王；隨即與十五歲的米連娜（沃庫提奇之女）結婚。
body.en: Nikola I was born at Njeguš on 7 October 1841. He spent his early childhood at Cetinje and attended secondary school at Trieste and Paris. In 1860 he broke off his studies to succeed his uncle, Prince Danilo, who had been assassinated at Kotor; he then married the fifteen-year-old Milena, daughter of the voivode Vukotić.

citations.quote: Nato a Njeguš il 7 ottobre 1841
Født 7. oktober 1841, Njeguš, Montenegro
Passata la prima fanciullezza a Cettigne
frequentò a Trieste e a Parigi le scuole medie.
Interruppe gli studî nel 1860, per succedere a suo zio, il principe Danilo
assassinato a Cattaro
Sposò subito la quindicenne Milena, figlia del voivoda Vukotić.

heading.en: Foreign policy and the Congress of Berlin

body.zh-Hant: 據Treccani條目，他年輕聰明、有野心，是塞爾維亞民族主義者，試圖領導反土耳其的起義，並於1866年與塞爾維亞結盟。第二次土耳其戰爭（1876至1878年）讓他在柏林會議上取得成功，獲得主權與領土擴張，包括阿德里亞海岸的杜爾奇尼奧與安提瓦里。1896年女兒埃琳娜與義大利王儲維托里奧·埃馬努埃萊結婚，為他帶來義大利的外交支持。
body.en: According to the Treccani entry he was an intelligent, ambitious young man and a Serb nationalist who tried to lead the anti-Turkish insurrection, and in 1866 he allied himself with Serbia. The second Turkish war (1876–1878) prepared his successes at the Congress of Berlin: sovereignty and territorial gain, including Dulcigno and Antivari on the Adriatic. The 1896 marriage of his daughter Elena to the Italian crown prince Vittorio Emanuele brought him Italian diplomatic support.

citations.quote: Giovane intelligente, ambizioso, nazionalista serbo
cercò di dirigere il movimento insurrezionale antiturco.
strinse alleanza con Milan di Serbia per la liberazione
l'unificazione di tutti i Serbi (1866)
La seconda guerra turca (1876-1878)
i successi del Congresso di Berlino
sovranità e aumento territoriale
con sbocco nell'Adriatico, a Dulcigno e Antivari
Il matrimonio della figlia Elena col principe ereditario italiano
Vittorio Emanuele (1896)
gli procurò l'aiuto diplomatico anche dell'Italia

body.zh-Hant: 國內方面，他設法推動國家現代化：1879年頒布一種類似憲法的文件，1905年頒布更完整的憲法，並設立學校、修築道路。1908年波士尼亞併吞危機時，他表示願與塞爾維亞一致行動。1910年適逢他執政五十週年，他自立為王；丹麥Lex亦記載他1910年自稱王號。
body.en: At home he sought to modernise the country: he granted a kind of constitution in 1879 and a fuller constitution in 1905, set up schools and had roads built. During the Bosnian annexation crisis of 1908 he showed himself ready to act in agreement with Serbia. In 1910, the fiftieth anniversary of his rule, he proclaimed himself king; the Danish Lex also records that in 1910 he took the royal title.

citations.quote: cercò di favorire la modernizzazione del suo paese
Concesse una specie di costituzione nel 1879
una costituzione più ampia nel 1905
Istituì scuole, fece costruire strade.
Durante la crisi dell'annessione della Bosnia (1908)
si mostrò pronto ad agire d'accordo con la Serbia.
Nel 1910, 50° anniversario del suo governo, si proclamò re.
og i 1910 tillagde han sig kongetitel.

body.zh-Hant: 1912年巴爾幹戰爭中他首先對土耳其開戰，1913年對保加利亞作戰時派一個師援助塞爾維亞；1914年世界大戰爆發，他立刻站到奧地利的對立面。1916年1月他開啟單獨和談，未成，由米爾科親王負責投降，他自己在布林迪西登陸後流亡。丹麥Lex指出，1918年國民議會正式廢黜了他。他最後死於法國昂蒂布。
body.en: In the Balkan war of 1912 he was the first to open hostilities against the Turks, in the war against the Bulgarians in 1913 he sent a division to help the Serbs, and when the World War began in 1914 he at once lined up against Austria. In January 1916 he began talks for a separate peace, which came to nothing; Prince Mirko made the surrender, while Nikola landed at Brindisi and went into exile. The Danish Lex states that in 1918 the National Assembly formally deposed him. He died at Antibes in France.

citations.quote: Nella guerra balcanica (1912), aperse le ostilità contro i Turchi
nella guerra contro i Bulgari (1913), inviò una divisione in aiuto dei Serbi
nella guerra mondiale (1914), si schierò subito contro l'Austria.
avviò, nel gennaio 1916, trattative per una pace separata.
Questa non fu stipulata, e N. dovette capitolare.
La resa fu fatta dal principe Mirko
sbarcato a Brindisi, andava in esilio
og 1918 blev han formelt afsat af Nationalforsamlingen.
Død 1. marts 1921, Antibes, Frankrig

heading.en: Origins, studies abroad and early posts

body.zh-Hant: 阿里亞斯生於1886年7月3日。來自哥斯大黎加的安東尼奧·阿里亞斯定居於科克萊省的里奧格蘭德，與卡門·馬德里成家。哈莫迪奧18歲赴利物浦；1909年以優異成績取得法學學位，同年進入倫敦大學經濟學院攻讀博士，1911年完成，論文題為《巴拿馬運河：美國外交研究》。回國後他任外交部副部長，1912年受任為法典編纂委員會成員。
body.en: Arias was born on 3 July 1886. The Costa Rican Antonio Arias had settled in Río Grande, Coclé province, and started a family with Carmen Madrid. At 18 Harmodio went to Liverpool; in 1909 he took his law degree with honours and the same year entered the doctorate at the London School of Economics of the University of London, completing it in 1911 with a thesis titled "The Panama Canal: a study of American diplomacy". On returning home he was appointed deputy foreign minister, and in 1912 he was named to the codification commission.

citations.quote: Harmodio Arias Madrid (b. 3 July 1886; d. 23 December 1962)
el costarricense Antonio Arias se establece en Río Grande, provincia de Coclé
funda una familia con Carmen Madrid
Con 18 años, viaja a Liverpool sin dominar el inglés
En 1909, obtuvo con honores su título de Licenciado en Derecho.
Ese año ingresa al doctorado

‘El Canal de Panamá: estudio sobre la diplomacia americana'
retorna a Panamá y es nombrado subsecretario de Relaciones Exteriores

heading.en: Teaching, the National Assembly and opposition to the treaty

body.zh-Hant: 1918至1920年他任法學院教授，並代表巴拿馬出席海牙的國際法院。Encyclopedia of Latin American History 記他1920至1924年任國民議會議員；巴拿馬大學的文章則記他當選1924至1928年任期的議員，並以 Acción Comunal 發言人的身分反對《阿爾法羅—凱洛格條約》，因而被稱為「孤獨的發言人」。前者並指他因反對批准1926年與美國的條約而深受歡迎。
body.en: From 1918 to 1920 he was a professor at the law school, and he represented Panama before the International Court of Justice at The Hague. The Encyclopedia of Latin American History records him as a deputy to the National Assembly in 1920–1924; the University of Panama article records him as elected deputy for the 1924–1928 term, speaking for Acción Comunal against the Alfaro-Kellogg Treaty, which earned him the name "Lone Spokesman". The former adds that he was very popular for opposing ratification of the 1926 treaty with the United States.

citations.quote: professor at the law school (1918–1920)
Panama's representative to the International Court of Justice at The Hague
deputy to the National Assembly (1920–1924)
Fue electo diputado para el periodo 1924 a 1928.
vocero de Acción Comunal, se opuso al Tratado Alfaro - Kellogg
por lo que se le llamó ‘Vocero Solitario'
He was very popular for his opposition to the ratification of the 1926 treaty

body.zh-Hant: 1931年1月2日，Acción Comunal 的青年成員發動該國第一次政變，阿里亞斯被指定為臨時政府首腦，任期自1月2日至15日；Encyclopedia of Latin American History 稱他是推翻佛洛倫西奧·阿羅塞梅納政府的1931年革命領導人之一。1932年他當選總統，任期1932至1936年；同一條目稱那是該國最自由、最誠實的選舉之一。
body.en: On 2 January 1931 young members of Acción Comunal carried out the country's first coup, and Arias was named provisional head of government from 2 to 15 January; the Encyclopedia of Latin American History calls him one of the leaders of the 1931 revolution that overthrew the government of Florencio Harmodio Arosemena. In 1932 he was elected president for 1932 to 1936, in what the same entry calls one of the freest and most honest elections the country had seen.

citations.quote: El 2 de enero de 1931, un grupo de jóvenes miembros de Acción Comunal
dan el primer golpe de Estado en el país
fue designado jefe provisional del Gobierno del 2 al 15 de enero de ese año
one of the leaders of the 1931 revolution
overthrew the government of Florencio Harmodio Arosemena
elegido presidente de la República para el periodo 1932 a 1936
one of the freest and most honest elections the country had seen

body.zh-Hant: 1933年他赴華盛頓，成為首位在任訪問白宮的拉丁美洲總統，目的之一是廢除1903年條約中美國「為維持秩序而干預」的條款。1936年他談成《阿里亞斯—羅斯福條約》，巴拿馬不再是被美國干預的國家。任內他重組審計長公署與國家銀行，設立工人與農民基金，並創辦巴拿馬大學，1935年10月7日揭幕。
body.en: In 1933 he travelled to Washington, becoming the first sitting Latin American president to visit the White House, one aim being to remove the clause of the 1903 treaty giving the United States the right to intervene to maintain order. In 1936 he secured the Arias-Roosevelt treaty, under which Panama ceased to be a nation subject to US intervention. As president he reorganised the Comptroller General's office and the National Bank, created the Workers' and Farmers' Fund, and founded the University of Panama, inaugurated on 7 October 1935.

citations.quote: En 1933 viaja a Washington, siendo así el primer presidente latinoamericano
en funciones que visita la Casa Blanca
Este viaje tenía entre sus objetivos eliminar la cláusula del Tratado de 1903
derecho de intervenir en la República para mantener el orden
En 1936 el presidente Arias logra un nuevo tratado
conocido como Arias - Roosevelt
Panamá deja de ser una nación intervenida por los Estados Unidos de América.
reorganizó la Contraloría General de la República y el Banco Nacional
Creó el Fondo del Obrero y del Agricultor
emite el decreto creándola y la inaugura el 7 de octubre de 1935
In 1935, Arias founded the University of Panama.

body.zh-Hant: 卸任後，他以《El Panamá-América》編輯的身分，仍是巴拿馬政壇有影響力的聲音。1962年12月23日凌晨，他在從波士頓返回巴拿馬的旅途中心臟病發去世。
body.en: After leaving the presidency he remained an influential voice in Panamanian politics as editor of El Panamá-América. In the early hours of 23 December 1962, on a journey from Boston to Panama, he suffered a heart attack and died.

citations.quote: As the editor of El Panamá-América
he continued to be an influential voice in Panamanian politics

people.name: Theobald von Bethmann Hollweg
people.nameZh: 泰奧巴爾德·馮·貝特曼·霍爾韋格

body.zh-Hant: 貝特曼·霍爾韋格1856年11月29日生於霍恩菲諾（Hohenfinow），父親費利克斯是騎士領地所有人。他1875年通過畢業考試，1879年通過法學見習考試後進入行政部門，1884年任政府陪審官。1886至1896年他接替父親任家鄉縣的縣長（Landrat），1890年又短暫以帝國黨成員身分擔任帝國議會議員。
body.en: Bethmann Hollweg was born at Hohenfinow on 29 November 1856, the son of the estate owner Felix von Bethmann Hollweg. He passed his school-leaving examination in 1875, passed the Referendar examination in 1879 and entered the administrative service, and became Regierungsassessor in 1884. From 1886 to 1896 he succeeded his father as Landrat of his home district, and in 1890 he briefly sat in the Reichstag in the ranks of the Reichspartei.

body.zh-Hant: 1896至1899年他任波茨坦的上級行政參議（Oberpräsidialrat），1899年夏任布隆貝格行政區長官，三個月後升任勃蘭登堡省總督（至1905年）。1905年3月他接替去世的哈默施泰因，出任普魯士內政大臣；1907年6月24日改任帝國內政署（Reichsamt des Innern）國務秘書，同時兼普魯士國務院副議長。
body.en: From 1896 to 1899 he was Oberpräsidialrat in Potsdam, in the summer of 1899 he became Regierungspräsident of Bromberg, and three months later Oberpräsident of the Province of Brandenburg (until 1905). In March 1905 he succeeded the late Hans von Hammerstein as Prussian Minister of the Interior; on 24 June 1907 he became State Secretary of the Reichsamt des Innern and at the same time Vice-President of the Prussian State Ministry.

body.zh-Hant: 1909年7月比洛離職後，他成為帝國首相，同時任普魯士首相與普魯士外交部長；首相就任日期兩份來源不同（NDB記7月7日，LeMO記7月14日）。1910年他改革普魯士選舉權的嘗試失敗，1911年他促成阿爾薩斯—洛林獲得較自由的憲法，1913年12月4日帝國議會因茨貝恩事件責難他的作法。
body.en: After Bülow's departure in July 1909 he became Reich Chancellor, and at the same time Prussian minister-president and Prussian foreign minister; the two sources differ on the date he took office (the NDB gives 7 July, LeMO 14 July). In 1910 his attempt to reform the Prussian franchise failed, in 1911 he secured a liberal constitution for Alsace-Lorraine, and on 4 December 1913 the Reichstag censured his handling of the Zabern affair.

body.zh-Hant: 1914年7月危機中，他在奧匈與塞爾維亞的衝突上立即堅決站到盟友一邊。NDB指出他並不相信德國會獲勝。1917年1月9日在普萊斯（Pleß）戰爭會議上，他屈從軍方領導層的壓力，同意展開無限制潛艇戰。同年7月，興登堡與魯登道夫出面干預，迫使皇帝免去他的職務（1917年7月13日）。
body.en: In the July crisis of 1914 he at once and decisively took the side of his ally in Austria-Hungary's conflict with Serbia. The NDB notes that he did not believe in a German victory. At the war council in Pleß on 9 January 1917 he yielded to the pressure of the military leadership and agreed to begin unrestricted submarine warfare. In July of that year Hindenburg and Ludendorff intervened and forced the Kaiser to dismiss him (13 July 1917).

body.zh-Hant: 免職後他退居從父親繼承的霍恩菲諾莊園。1919年10月31日與11月4日，他在國民議會調查委員會的第二小組受詢。他於1921年1月1日夜至2日間在霍恩菲諾因肺炎去世；NDB記死亡日為1月1日，GND記為1月2日。
body.en: After his dismissal he withdrew to the Hohenfinow estate he had inherited from his father. On 31 October and 4 November 1919 he appeared before the second subcommittee of the parliamentary committee of inquiry of the National Assembly. He died of pneumonia at Hohenfinow in the night between 1 and 2 January 1921; the NDB gives the date of death as 1 January and the GND as 2 January.
